steps.text: 9:50 A.M. \ Sunny
Rhodes Island Landship, Compartment 2, Cafeteria

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: North Kjerag-style stir-fried greens, sprinkled with a little Rhodes Island Special Seasoning....

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: And we're done.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Wow! Looks delicious!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Such leafy greens are rare in Kjerag, so I don't often get to cook dishes like this. Your approval brings me joy.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Things are different in the snowfields of Kjerag. Many goods are hard to come by, even with money. It's not like here on this landship, where supplies are so plentiful.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Supplies.... I think I heard Closure say something about that.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I guess Rhodes Island has like a special procurement channel that brings supplies and stuff to the ship.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: They have bases all over the place, so we can get all kinds of different ingredients from different places.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That explains it. But they really have bases all over?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Um... I guess they're like offices or something? I don't really get this stuff.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: That reminds me, wasn't there a wishlist on the bulletin board outside the cafeteria? If there's anything special you like to eat, you can write it up there!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I heard those pretty girls in procurement check it every day!

steps.name: Procurement Agent A
steps.text: You're too sweet, Gummy! Call me pretty again and I'll bring you back some candy next time.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You're gorgeous!

steps.name: Procurement Agent A
steps.text: Atta-girl.

steps.name: Procurement Agent B
steps.text: Seriously...?

steps.name: Procurement Agent B
steps.text: Matterhorn, right? Just make a note of whatever you need on that bulletin board there and we'll procure it for you, if we get the chance.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I understand. I'll make use of it if I find myself in need. Your efforts humble me.

steps.name: Procurement Agent B
steps.text: No need to go that far. This is our job, after all.

steps.name: Procurement Agent A
steps.text: What's with the stiffness? We're all friends here. Loosen up and talk like human beings already.

steps.name: Procurement Agent B
steps.text: You need to take our work more seriously!

steps.name: Procurement Agent B
steps.text: Don't mind her. We have things to do, so we'll get out of your hair for now.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehe. Everybody's so nice. Last time we moored by a city, Closure even took me shopping with her!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The stuff she bought was kinda weird.... But I still had fun!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Haha, I heard about that. Dr. Kal'tsit was very upset when she bought a big stone mask?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ahahahaha. Yeah! That mask was so creepy! I tried it on once.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Next time you see something so strange, perhaps you shouldn't touch it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Ah, the food has cooled down and the temperature is perfect.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Mm. It's salty. This flavor may be a little bit much...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm sure it's great.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Do you think I could try some? Can I? Please let me have some, Uncle Matterhorn!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: U- uncle...?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (Am I that old now...?)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Of course you can. In fact, it would be a big help to me if you were my taste tester.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hooray!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehehe, c'mon, lemme try... Oh?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Huh? What's wrong?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Um.... Hm. I kinda feel like there's less food on this plate than there was a second ago?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: So weird. Am I going crazy...?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh well. Gimme a bite!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ommmm——nom.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (chewing and munching)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: How... how is it?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Omnom nomnom. Gulp.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's great!!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The veggies are crunchy and juicy and super refreshing and seasoned juuust right. It's really, really good!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: O- oh? I appreciate the compliment.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But I think you're exaggerating a bit. This is a simple recipe designed for home cooking. I can put a copy up in the kitchen for everyone to try.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hooray!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll also let you try my secret recipe for Ursus frozen vegetable soup, Uncle Matterhorn. It's super healthy! Ooh, it'll be like a trade~

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sounds delicious. I'll give it a try the next time I'm preparing a midnight snack for the Ladies.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehehe. I'm sure Pramanix and Cliffheart will love it~

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (The Lady and the Young Lady, hm...?)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: By the way, Gummy, shouldn't you send along that stew you've been preparing?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's for the Doctor, isn't it? It will get cold if we leave it any longer, and that will affect the taste.... won't it?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oooh! I almost forgot!!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I better get going! Uncle Matterhorn! The stir-fried greens are mega delicious! Save me the recipe!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What a vivacious little girl.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Show yourself.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Then, you'll have to pardon me——
Oof!
Come on, man.
Are we really up to blades and guns now? Where did you pull that out of anyway? And what's it doing in the kitchen? You could hurt somebody.
*Sigh* How'd you know I was here? I thought I was pretty well hidden.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (biting apple)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Stealing food from the kitchen again? There's no need for that. If you're hungry, just go to the cafeteria.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Did you not learn your lesson last time? I recall a logistics operator telling you if you were caught using your powers to take food or ingredients without permission again, you would be punished appropriately.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Punishment? Oh, you mean the one  where they make me wear a sign that says 'I took food from the kitchen'?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: What kind of punishment is that? I thought they were joking.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hey, wait a minute, you still didn't tell me how you found me.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: If you hadn't swiped some of the dish I just made, I wouldn't have noticed your presence.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Ahhh, I blew it.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I was just going to see if there were any breakfast leftovers I could eat, but that stuff you made smelled so good I couldn't resist.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Sorry, so sorry. Infinitely sorry. More sorry than sorry can be. You don't care that much, do you?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I care.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Phew, that's a relief, I th... Huh?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Wait a minute? What did you just say?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I said I care.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Woah, woah, woah.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (No way, this could be bad.)

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (If he's gonna get stuck in on this thing, this is a problem that could go places!)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You....

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Ah, huh? What?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ——You didn't use a fork. You grabbed the food with your hands. And you didn't even wash them!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That's unsanitary! It's unacceptable!

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: So that's... all you care about?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hygiene is no laughing matter! Show respect to your food, especially when it's handmade. Every serving of this dish contains a piece of my heart!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Wait, you washed that apple first, didn't you? You need to take care of yourself, as a warrior!

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: All right, all right, I get it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That's the same attitude Instructor Dobermann is always getting upset about.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Anyway, I shouldn't be butting my horns in there.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Come on, I'm really turning over a new leaf here.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: It's just that, hey, sometimes old habits die hard. And it's the kind of thing I never got to worry about.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: But you got one thing wrong. I did remember to wash my hands this time.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Just splashing water over them for a second doesn't count as washing your hands.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: You're a real hardass, man.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Okay, whatever, I'll remember next time.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Frivolous little...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Oh, by the way, how did you find the dish you just tasted?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Dish? You mean the stir-fried greens?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Didn't that Gummy girl already stroke your ego? Need a quick tug from me too? Sure, fine. It blew me away, incredible flavor. And your biceps are huge.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Any additional glib remarks?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Oh yeah, tons.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Save them. I'm not sure how much longer I can hold myself back from educating you.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hahaha. Seriously, do you really want to hear the truth?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: All right. I'll give it to you straight. The dish is good, it's tasty. But, how do I put this? I get a confusing feeling when I eat it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Don't talk nonsense. My cooking isn't capable of sparking such feelings.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Gee, you're really no fun at all.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: But sure. You know, I saw you sigh a few times while you were cooking.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Like full on. You were spacing out, and sighing to yourself. It's hard to imagine you put out food this good in a state like that.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Stop, stop.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Forget it, man, don't force it if you don't want to. I don't care at all, really.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I dunno what's bothering you. But just some advice from ol' Ethan, take a look at the big picture, and don't do this to yourself.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Look at me. There was me, back there, but I'm over that. Can't do anything about it anyway, might as well not think about it. Life at Rhodes Island is good.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hey, changing the subject, I just wanna ask, what's cooking in your pot over there? Smells really good.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ........That's braised beastmeat. It's ready to go. I'm about to sprinkle some cheese on it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's a traditional Kjerag dish. Snowlanders all grow up eating it. I've made some slight adjustments to make the beastmeat more tender.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Oh! That sounds awesome!

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Can I try this too?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Wait, not that, that's——
Here you are, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Master! When did you get to Rhodes Island? And why didn't you inform me you were coming?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Just a moment, I'll make you some tea.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: No need, I'm only passing through.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: It's just a matter of talking to the Doctor about some Kjerag issues. It all came up pretty suddenly, so I didn't have time to tell you.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: There is a lot of pressure. The Master is pushing himself too hard.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Setting that aside, Matterhorn, how is Ensia these days?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The Young Lady is in good spirits and her condition is under control.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: As you instructed, Courier and I have been keeping an eye on the Lady's health. I prepare a separate lunch for her, to avoid any adverse reactions to Rhodes Island's food.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: That's good. Heat up another pot of salted milk tea while you're at it, Ensia always liked that.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Your tastes haven't changed, nor have hers, Master.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: As you wish, Master.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Well, that's that.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I prepared that specially for the Young Lady, at the Master's command. I'll be bringing it to her later. If you're still hungry, I can prepare something else for you.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah, that'd be great. I really wanna get some of that tender meat.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's very precious food. Specially requested from operators who were passing by that base. This is all we have.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Not to mention, braised meat takes a tremendous amount of time. You'll just have to make do with regular fried beastmeat.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: This is discrimination!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Beggars can't be choosers!

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Fine! I'll earn the good stuff!

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: That Master you're talking about, he's your boss, right?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: That's Master SilverAsh who pops up every now and then to chat up the Doctor?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That's right. You've met the Master?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Whether you have or not, I advise you to take a more respectful tone.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I called him 'Master,' is that not respectful enough?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Anyway, that boss of yours, I heard he's got a couple of younger sisters?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yes. What of them?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: That Feline girl named Ensia, she's your 'Young Lady,' isn't she?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Real sweet of her brother to send you along to feed her home cooking. He worried the foreign stuff won't agree with her?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: So that's the 'Young Lady.' Where's the 'Old Lady?'

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...What exactly are you asking?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The matter of the Ladies is the Master's private affair. You'd best not ask such questions.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Whew, that's a scary face. Chill, I'm not dumb enough to go sticking my nose into rich people business.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Ah, pass that sauce bottle over there for me.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: This one? Here you go.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Welcome. Ooh, that's starting to smell good.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: And we're done. It's just plain fried beastmeat. But I made a few substitutions. It should taste all right.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: There's bread in the basket over there, and there should be rice in the pot next to it. You can have whatever you like. I need to bring this to the Young Lady now.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Remember to wash your hands before you eat.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Get outta here. Are you my mother?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: No. Thankfully, I'm not.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: ...Yeah, get going.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: *Sigh*. Too bad. That braised meat smelled amazing.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Guess I'll wash my hands.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Weird. Since when am I such a good boy?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Okay, do the soap, the thirty seconds on each hand.... Three, two, one. And we're good.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (shaking out his hands)

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Safe.
At least wipe your hands before you grab the bread.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Who's that?
...Nobody. Just a blacksmith.
Hm? Where's Matterhorn?
Thanks, Matterhorn, for the tea.
Mmm, it smells good. Is there some sesame oil in it? That's how I used to take it when I was little. I can't believe you still remember.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You humble me, my Lady.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Now then, I'll leave you to enjoy it. I must be off.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (It must have been the Master who put the sesame oil in the tea for her when she was small.)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (But the Master hasn't had salted milk tea like this since he came back from Victoria. He must have forgotten.)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (My Lady...)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (The Young Lady picked out all the peppers again this time. She's been doing that since she was small.)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (If you keep being so picky with your food, you won't get a balanced diet. Things will only get worse...)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Hmm?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That reminds me, the Master would, in such cases....

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (No, don't go down that road.)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (It's too dangerous an issue. Better just forget about it.)
Hey, hey, hey, big guy——

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hm? Who's there?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: It's me! You see something floating down the corridor, who else could it be?! You stupid?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Whatever. Here, take this. Don't drop it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What's——

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: There you go. I got a thing. Later.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ........He's gone.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What is he doing? It's a... sandwich?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: He burned the bread, didn't cut the edges, and sliced the scalesaur meat too thick, it's...
Cut him a break.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: He worked hard on it. Even put in some tangerine slices. It should taste fine.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ........Vulcan.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You must be here for my shield. I left it with a few other pieces that need fixing in the kitchen. I'll fetch them for you.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's okay, I'll go with.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That guy was pretty chatty while working on that sandwich.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Did Ethan say something unpleasant to you? Let me apologize on his behalf. He speaks without thinking, but there's no malice in him....

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Err, no. Slow down there. It's nothing like that.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: He said he wanted to give Uncle Matterhorn a taste of 'aimless youth cuisine,' as a token of appreciation.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I guess he put his heart into it. Oh and he walked off with two plates of food that were sitting in the kitchen.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What nonsense. Such hooliganism.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It is. But why do I get the sense that you kinda like it?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That's ridiculous.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Look me in the eye and say that.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ........By the way, how old is Ethan?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Where does he get off calling me 'Uncle?'
